q: For a sequence of measurable functions fₙ → f pointwise a.e. on a finite measure space, Egorov's theorem guarantees:
opts: Uniform convergence outside a set of arbitrarily small measure
exp: Egorov's theorem: on a finite measure space, pointwise a.e. convergence implies 'almost uniform' convergence—uniform convergence outside sets of measure ε for any ε > 0.
